item.title: 🔴 GitHub Investigating TeamPCP Claimed Breach of ~4,000 Internal Repositories
item.description:

item.title: 🔴 Cybercrime service disrupted for abusing Microsoft platform to sign malware
item.description:
Why this matters: Elevated ransomware risk — validate backups and endpoint defenses.
Microsoft says it has disrupted a malware-signing-as-a-service (MSaaS) operation that abused the company's Artifact Signing service to generate fraudulent code-signing certificates used by ransomware gangs and other cybercriminals. [...]
